info.description: Repair tracking platform for mechanics, auto shops, and fleet managers.
info.title: mechatracker API

get.description: Returns all vehicles with per-system summaries and org-level stats in one call.
Returns in-progress repairs assigned to or created by the caller.

post.description: Creates a new repair in draft status for a vehicle.

get.description: Returns the repair record with its steps and parts in one response.

delete.description: Hard-deletes a repair and writes a 30-day recoverable snapshot to deleted_items.

patch.description: Handles two operations: status transition (provide `status`) or field edits (provide `title`/`system`/`assigned_to`). Completing a repair writes an immutable history snapshot.

get.description: Returns all timestamped notes for a repair, newest last.

post.description: Creates a timestamped note on the repair, attributed to the caller.
post.summary: Add a note to a repair

post.description: Creates a part entry on a repair, starting in `needed` status. Cost is a decimal string e.g. "34.99".
post.summary: Add a part to a repair

delete.description: Removes a part from a repair. Only allowed when status is draft or in_progress.

patch.description: Updates part fields (name, part_number, supplier, cost, notes). Allowed on any non-completed repair.
Transitions a part through its lifecycle: needed → ordered → in_stock → installed. Invalid transitions are rejected.

post.description: Returns a presigned URL for direct-to-Spaces photo upload. Not yet implemented — wire DigitalOcean Spaces config first.
Adds a step to a repair. Only allowed when repair status is draft or in_progress.
post.summary: Add a step to a repair

delete.description: Removes a step from a repair. Only allowed when status is draft or in_progress.

post.description: Toggles a step between complete and incomplete. Recalculates repair progress_pct after the toggle.

get.description: Returns all vehicles belonging to the caller's org.

post.description: Adds a vehicle to the caller's org garage.

get.description: Returns a single vehicle by ID, scoped to the caller's org.

delete.description: Hard-deletes a vehicle and writes a 30-day recoverable snapshot to deleted_items.

patch.description: Partially updates a vehicle. Only provided fields are changed.

get.description: Returns completed repair snapshots from repair_history, ordered newest first.
get.summary: List repair history for a vehicle

get.description: Returns all repairs for a vehicle, optionally filtered by system.

parameters.description: Filter by system key (e.g. engine, brakes)
parameters.name: system

delete.description: Deletes all repairs (and their steps, parts, notes) for the given vehicle+system.
delete.summary: Delete all repairs in a system for a vehicle

post.description: Receives and verifies Clerk webhook events. Handles user.created to provision org + user.

body.example: Noticed some scoring on the rotor — ordered replacement.

status.description: Status must follow the allowed progression: needed → ordered → in_stock → installed.
Status transition — mutually exclusive with field edits.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the Clerk JWT.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
